title: About Me
body:
I'm Francesco, a developer based in Europe with a background in aviation and a deep passion for building things on the web. I started learning programming to create tools and products that reflect the kind of life I want to live: independent, location-flexible, and focused on meaningful work.

Today I mainly work with React, Next.js, and modern web technologies, building projects that combine clean design, practical functionality, and long-term thinking.
